source.createdBy: NASA/JPL Navigation and Ancillary Information Facility

models.frame: IAU_MOON Mean Earth/Polar Axis text-PCK approximation
models.sourceBasis: IAU 2009 lunar rotational elements retained by NAIF because WGCCRE 2015 no longer supplies Moon elements

models.frame: IAU body-fixed frames relative to ICRF J2000
models.sourceBasis: IAU WGCCRE 2015 rotational elements and Jupiter-system periodic terms

spaceViewerContract.evaluation: Local deterministic trigonometric-polynomial evaluation from the shared simulation timestamp
spaceViewerContract.frameTransform: ICRF pole and prime-meridian basis rotated to J2000 mean ecliptic, then mapped into SpaceViewer scene axes
spaceViewerContract.fallback: Moons outside the controlled five retain a fixed surface presentation and disclose that no controlled attitude model is installed
spaceViewerContract.textureBoundary: The shared texture bundle has no verified cartographic seam or longitude-origin metadata, so landmark alignment is not claimed
spaceViewerContract.accuracyBoundary: Generic visualisation-grade orientation. NAIF recommends binary lunar PCK and frame kernels for higher-accuracy lunar work; natural-satellite models can change with new observations. Not for mission operations or navigation.
